verdicts.reason: A: the reading order is reversed, with the 'Shop Sale' CTA on the far left before the headline and the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow moved below the fine print. Otherwise the type steps are clean and the large can sits well on the circle, though there is dead space along the bottom. B has the same reversed order, and its CTA is jammed close to the left edge and almost touches '20% off'. The can is shrunk so far that the SOLSTICE label can't be read, and the huge circle leaves a dead gap in the middle, so the product is reduced to a trivial element.
